entries.rationale: Toggle truth table; target has 2, 3, 4 set bits; 3, 4, 5 consequential choices. Test-only approval cannot commission a public candidate.

Small walking graph; persistent key masks; D4 seed transforms; room-entry legal choices 2/3/4 and independent shortest normal inputs 2/4/6. Every entry alternative returns without collecting keys. No candidate code, DOM, eval or mutation adapter.

Six distinct 4x4 edge layouts; bounded key/gate masks; independent BFS minimums, key-order regret and consequential route choices. All reachable states solvable; entry normal-input return paths preserved. Offline data model only.
